exposure: 22 inorganic elements (including Cd, Cr, Ni, Hg, Pb)
outcome: Concentrations of 22 inorganic elements in amniotic fluid
cohort: 65 pregnant women from Hospital Universitario de Canarias (Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain).
finding: All 22 inorganic elements were detected in measurable amounts in amniotic fluid, demonstrating that toxic inorganic elements pass into and accumulate in AF.
cross-section timing: At the time of amniotic fluid sample collection during pregnancy/delivery
